description: Combining beautiful HD graphics, realistic physics and easy-to-use controls, Offroad Racing is a unique and fun racing game for Windows. Collect coins to upgrade your vehicles and unlock new levels. Perform stunts to earn extra coins. With loads of exciting and tricky levels, Offroad Racing provides you endless hours of fun. Features: - Beautiful HD graphics - Realistic physics - 6 vehicles - Vehicle upgrades (engine, suspension, tires, air-controllability) - 3 level packs (Hills, Arctic, Mars) - 45 tricky levels - Perform stunts to earn extra coins - Leaderboards and achievements - Share your
